d: At Carlo's Bakery, every order brings a new challenge, and Buddy Valastro and his team are always ready to take it on. From elaborate themed cakes to creative designs that demand expert cake decorating, the bakery is buzzing with tight deadlines, unexpected hurdles, and plenty of action. Get a look at the cake artists behind the amazing creations as they turn ambitious ideas into custom cakes. Watch Cake Boss Season 7 Episodes 7, 8, 9, 11, 12, 14 and 15 only on discovery+ India.
